title: Carrying Optional Extras Already Bought onto a Voucher — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Optional extras already bought on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking may be carried onto the travel credit voucher raised when the booking is cancelled. Two readings decide how they are measured: how far ahead of the outbound departure the latest optional-extra line was posted, and how many checked bags the fare brand includes.

## 1. The measure

1.1 Where the latest optional-extra line was posted more than 7 days ahead of the outbound departure and the fare brand includes at least 1 checked bag, the optional extras are carried as the sum of every optional-extra line standing on the booking.

1.2 Where the latest optional-extra line was posted more than 7 days ahead of the outbound departure and the fare brand includes no checked bag, they are carried as the largest single optional-extra line, multiplied by the travellers ticketed.

1.3 In every other case no such carrying is made.

The lead is counted in days from the posting date of the latest optional-extra line to the outbound departure date, and must exceed 7 days; a line posted exactly 7 days ahead does not exceed it.

## 2. Condition matrix

| Latest optional-extra line posted | Checked bags the brand includes | How the extras are measured |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than 7 days ahead of the outbound departure | 1 or more | the sum of every optional-extra line standing on the booking |
| more than 7 days ahead of the outbound departure | none | the largest single optional-extra line, multiplied by the travellers ticketed |
| 7 days or fewer ahead of the outbound departure | any | no such carrying |

## 3. Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

A booking with 2 travellers ticketed carries optional-extra lines of 45.00, 30.00 and 22.00 USD, the latest of them posted 20 days ahead of the outbound departure, and is held in a brand including 1 checked bag. The extras are carried as the sum of the three lines, 97.00 USD.

The same booking held in a brand including no checked bag: the extras are carried as the largest single line, 45.00 USD, taken for each of 2 travellers, giving 90.00 USD.

The same booking whose latest optional-extra line was posted 3 days ahead of the outbound departure: 3 days does not exceed 7, so no such carrying is made whatever the brand includes.
